Why governance matters

Governance is more than a checklist — it's the steady foundation that keeps agents dependable. This matters most when teams scale. Just as important, it adds another layer of trust for leadership.

Hooks are more than scripts, they're guardrails. Rather than simply blocking commands, a good hook explains why. This matters because agents learn from the feedback in stderr. Looking ahead, the next lesson covers Stop hooks.
